lines.t: Whispers in my head, screens keep flashing red,
Scrolling through the noise, lost in what’s unsaid.
Eyes glued to the glowing light, comparing every night,
Perfect lives parade, but what’s real feels out of sight.
Pressure’s on to be the best, can’t afford the rest,
In this race with no clear end, my heart beats like a test.
Fear the judgment, fear to fail,
A silent shout inside the veil.
Caught in a web of digital lines,
Anxieties wrapped in perfect designs.
But I’ll rise, break free, find my own way,
In this noisy world, I’ll learn to stay.
Every like, a fleeting high, dopamine runs dry,
Seeking validation in the echo, wondering why.
FOMO’s grip, the constant chase, feels like a losing race,
Crafting masks, avoiding eyes, trapped inside this space.
Fear the judgment, fear to fail,
A silent shout inside the veil.
Caught in a web of digital lines,
Anxieties wrapped in perfect designs.
But I’ll rise, break free, find my own way,
In this noisy world, I’ll learn to stay.
Beneath the surface calm I show,
The storm of thoughts won’t let me go,
But through the silence, I will fight,
Find peace within the fading night.
When the void calls out my name, and shadows cover flame,
The Lord reaches down His hand, to heal and make me whole again.
In His love, the fear rescinds, a calm my soul depends,
He fills the cracks where doubt had spread, and lifts the weight inside my head.
Caught in His arms, I’m safe and sound,
From anxious webs, I’m breaking ground.
He is my light, my guide, my stay,
In His refuge, I’ll always stay.
Whispers fade, the screen goes dim,
A quiet breath, my light within.
